description: This file contains unit tests for the CounterAggregatorGroup class, which is part of Orleans' instrumentation and metrics infrastructure. The tests verify caching behavior, collection of metrics, and thread-safety under high concurrency.

classes.name: CounterAggregatorGroupTests
classes.description: Unit tests for the CounterAggregatorGroup class, focusing on caching, metric collection, and concurrency correctness.

methods.name: CounterAggregatorGroupTests
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test class with a test output helper.

methods.description: Test that the CounterAggregatorGroup caches aggregator instances to prevent duplicates for the same metric name and tags.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Test that the group correctly collects and sums metrics from multiple aggregators.

methods.name: TestMultithreadedCorrectness
methods.description: Stress test to verify thread-safety and correctness of metrics collection under high concurrency.
